# SHAT Development & Growth Platform (شركة شات للتنمية والتطوير)

> SHAT Development & Growth is an international consulting and executive training house specializing in capacity building, institutional strengthening, and results advancement aligned with global humanitarian standards (CHS, PSEA, OECD DAC, Sphere, INEE).

## Core Capabilities & Services
- [Corporate Home & Overview](https://shat-company-platform.vercel.app/#/home): Executive introduction, mission, pillars, and operational framework.
- [Training Academy & LMS Portal](https://shat-company-platform.vercel.app/#/academy): Accredited training programs, Case Management, Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) Master Diploma, and field practitioner certifications.
- [Institutional Consulting & Advisory](https://shat-company-platform.vercel.app/#/services): Organizational development, MEAL systems, third-party monitoring, evaluation, and policy design.
- [International Standards Matrix](https://shat-company-platform.vercel.app/#/standards): Compliance frameworks covering CHS Alliance, PSEA, OECD DAC, Sphere, and Do No Harm.
- [Field Projects & Interventions](https://shat-company-platform.vercel.app/#/projects): Portfolio of delivered capacity-strengthening projects and community interventions.
- [Digital Verification & Certification](https://shat-company-platform.vercel.app/#/verify): Secure QR and code validator for accredited certificates.
- [Institutional Readiness Diagnostic](https://shat-company-platform.vercel.app/#/toolkits): Interactive multi-axis institutional health checker for NGOs and companies.
- [Corporate Contact & Inquiries](https://shat-company-platform.vercel.app/#/contact): Official communication channels, advisory consultation requests, and direct WhatsApp support.
